approve.purpose: Automate weekly on-call rotation handoff: summarize open incidents, draft handoff notes, and require the outgoing engineer to confirm before rotating.

steps.name: Gather open incidents
steps.purpose: Pull all incidents touched in the last 7 days from the tracker

steps.name: Draft handoff notes
steps.purpose: Summarize status, owners, and next actions per incident

steps.name: Confirm handoff (approval gate)
steps.purpose: Outgoing engineer reviews and approves before rotation completes

params.name: onCallChannel
params.desc: Slack channel to post the handoff summary to

params.name: lookbackDays
params.desc: How many days of incidents to include (default 7)
